requirements.title: Plan Workshop Agent Manager Contract
requirements.description: Plan Workshop invokes only its declared review and reconciliation workflows through Agent Manager, then projects typed outputs into the session without auto-applying a canonical plan.

validation.notes: A review workflow result is projected once into the Plan Workshop session.
A proposal response creates exactly one reconciliation engagement.
Reconciliation produces a candidate; only Plan Manager may apply canonical changes.

requirements.title: Plan Workshop Workflow Integration
requirements.description: The operator explicitly starts Plan Workshop review or reconciliation. Legacy research, workshop-round, finalize, and auto-advance execution paths are retired.

validation.notes: Responses are idempotent and stale subject versions are rejected.
A changed subject invalidates the review packet instead of silently continuing.
Historical rounds migrate once and remain read-only.
Execution acceptance is an explicit server-side gate tied to the canonical plan.
Plan Workshop uses its canonical packet path exactly once per response.
Reconciliation retains a candidate for Plan Manager control; no automatic canonical apply occurs.
Phased-plan workflow results apply automatically through the existing execution worker

requirements.title: Entity-first Agent Session Context Attachment
requirements.description: Routed Swarm Manager entity detail pages let operators attach the current backlog item, initiative, capture, execution, scenario, operating mode, or session to a compatible Agent Session by staging a typed context ref in the target session composer. The staged context must follow the existing session-kind compatibility and context cap policy, and the operator must still explicitly send or start the session message.

validation.ref: ui/src/components/session/context/pending-session-context.test.ts::stages context by session without duplicating the same ref [REQ:REQ-P1-010-SESSION-CONTEXT]
validation.notes: Pending context handoff storage deduplicates staged typed refs by session.

validation.ref: ui/src/components/session/context/pending-session-context.test.ts::merges compatible context and rejects incompatible context visibly [REQ:REQ-P1-010-SESSION-CONTEXT]
validation.notes: Composer handoff merge enforces compatibility and cap policy instead of silently accepting invalid refs.

validation.ref: ui/src/pages/SessionDetailsPage.test.tsx::applies staged context and sends it with the next continuation [REQ:REQ-P1-010-SESSION-CONTEXT]
validation.notes: Session detail consumes staged context and sends it through the existing continue request.
